headline.title: A quiet Friday, with the leftovers still intact
headline.quip: No fleets grounded, no networks dark, no status pages in mourning. The nation’s infrastructure apparently took the day after Thanksgiving off, which is more than most of its maintainers got.
headline.summary: The archivist found no verified, widely reported disruption that began on November 27. Nothing met the two-source bar, so today’s door stays shut on facts and open on shrugging.
